_doc: LN1 line types (src/lines.h, docs/lines.md). A line is an Instance of `asset` (content/assets/line_<id>.json, a "line" block naming this type) with its points in extra.line. `builder` names a LINE_BUILDER ("trench": the GX1 trench network in terrain_blend.cpp). `spacing`: nominal bay length (m); `params`: per-type defaults a line may override. LN2 appends fence, wire, wall and hedge types here.

params._doc: fire: the parapet's low fire side (left | right | none, along the drawing direction); ramps: entry ramps at the line's ends (both | start | end | none; an end that joins another line never gets one); traverse: a dogleg every N m (0 = none)
